item.description:
More reliable automatic recording

  • Native meeting recording now continues when the meeting app replaces its call window, including while muted.
  • A verified call's existing microphone process can keep recording active when its window information disappears. Unrelated audio and output alone do not extend recording.
  • Completed recordings now show why recording stopped. This information is saved locally and retained through transcription.
  • Includes the menu-bar recording indicator introduced in version 0.3.5.

Existing recordings, settings, and the stable app signing identity are preserved. Regression checks passed; real-call validation of this fix remains required.

Meeting Memory 0.3.5

Meeting Memory now shows a clear status in the macOS menu bar while it is running.

- MM · Listening shows that automatic meeting detection is ready; it does not mean a recording has started.
- Recording displays a red recording symbol and elapsed time. Paused recordings, processing, privacy mode, manual mode, and setup requirements have distinct labels.
- Click the indicator for recording controls, the meeting library, Settings, and updates.
- A new Show status in the menu bar switch in Settings lets you hide or restore the indicator. It is enabled by default and remains available when the library window is closed.

This update uses the same signed app identity and preserves recordings, settings, and existing permissions. No recording starts merely by opening the menu.

Meeting Memory 0.3.4

Meeting Memory 0.3.4 improves long-meeting analysis, delivery recovery, and audio capture diagnostics.

- Longer meetings receive analysis time per section. A failed section gets one summary-only retry, then a clearly labeled extractive fallback while later sections continue. Summary headings use readable timestamps.
- Multipart ChatGPT uploads are spaced 90 seconds apart to reduce omitted payloads in cloud task handoffs. Exact exports are retained privately for recovery. Upload acceptance is explicitly distinguished from verified saving in Meetings.
- The meeting menu adds Refresh notes and Retry saving in ChatGPT. Recovery retries keep the original content and cloud deduplication identifiers.
- Automatic capture refreshes the selected app's audio helpers during a call. Silent or near-silent tracks produce a visible capture-quality warning and retain audio. Track labels no longer claim to identify speakers.

A five-part synthetic cloud delivery was verified character-for-character. This does not guarantee every future cloud task succeeds. Actual remote-participant audio capture still requires a consenting live call on this version. No recordings or credentials are included in this release.
